name: pam_xauth
description: Forward X authentication credentials to new sessions
detailed_description: Session module that forwards X11 (X Window System) authentication credentials from login sessions to new sessions. Enables X11 applications to run in new sessions with proper authorization. Particularly useful for su/sudo with X11 applications.
notes:
Enables X11 authentication forwarding for new sessions. Requires X11 and xauth utilities.
